screen.title: Conversation: Revising a news story
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student reporter and the editor of the student newspaper.

audio.text: Jamal, I've read your piece on the new food trucks. The writing's lively, but right now it's mostly your own impressions.
Well, I did spend a whole afternoon watching how busy they were.
Which is useful, but readers will want to hear from someone who's responsible for the program. Have you contacted the campus services office?
I emailed them on Monday, but nobody's replied.
Then give them a call. We can hold the story for Thursday's issue, but not any longer.
Okay. I'll phone them first thing tomorrow.

questions.stem: What is the editor's main concern about the story?
options: It is written in a style that readers may find dull
It was handed in well after the deadline for this week's issue
It includes incorrect prices for the food trucks
It relies too heavily on the reporter's personal observations

why.en: Main concern (paraphrase of "mostly your own impressions"). A contradicts "The writing's lively"; B misreads the plan to hold the story for Thursday's issue.
why.tr: Asıl endişe ("mostly your own impressions" ifadesinin parafrazı). A "The writing's lively" ile çelişiyor; B haberin perşembe sayısına bekletilmesini yanlış yorumluyor.
why.es: Preocupación principal (paráfrasis de "mostly your own impressions"). A contradice "The writing's lively"; B malinterpreta el plan de guardar la noticia para el número del jueves.

questions.stem: What will the reporter most likely do next?
options: Send the office a second email
Try to reach the office by telephone
Ask the editor to run it now

why.en: Next action: "I'll phone them first thing tomorrow". A is the method that has already failed; D contradicts the plan to hold the story.
why.tr: Sonraki adım: "I'll phone them first thing tomorrow". A zaten işe yaramamış olan yöntem; D haberi bekletme planıyla çelişiyor.
why.es: Siguiente paso: "I'll phone them first thing tomorrow". A es el método que ya no funcionó; D contradice el plan de guardar la noticia.
